[brreg_enheter] Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Finn Poulsen; board chair Anders Holch Povlsen; 2 other board members. [brreg_roller]

- Registered employees: 279 (as of 2026-09-10); 35 registered sub-units. [brreg_enheter]
